ba.ready.text: Hi, I'm Ziggy! Can you help at my busy airport today?

ba.back.text: Welcome back, ground crew! The planes are waiting.

ba.story.1.text: This is Ziggy. Today his airport opens for the first holiday flights!

ba.story.2.text: But oh dear! Everything is in a muddle.

ba.story.3.text: Bags are mixed up, the runway is dark, and a little plane is lost.

ba.story.4.text: Will you be Ziggy's ground crew and help fix it all?

ba.story.mid1.text: The airport is waking up. Nice teamwork!

ba.story.mid2.text: Halfway there! The holiday travellers are cheering.

ba.story.mid3.text: Nearly ready! The first plane is warming up its engines.

ba.story.end1.text: Everything is ready! The first holiday plane rolls to the runway.

ba.story.end2.text: Three, two, one... whoosh! Up it goes into the sky!

ba.story.end3.text: You sorted, counted and kept trying. Here's your Ground Crew sticker!

ba.prompt.bags.colour.text: Put each bag on the plane with the same colour!

ba.prompt.bags.shape.text: Look at each bag's tag. Find the plane with the same shape!

ba.prompt.bags.both.text: Match the colour and the shape! Every bag has one plane.

ba.prompt.count.text: Tap each passenger to help them climb aboard!

ba.prompt.make.text: Ziggy needs {nWord} passengers. Help them climb aboard!

ba.prompt.lights.next.text: Which light comes next? Keep the pattern going!

ba.prompt.lights.fill.text: Finish the runway lights. Keep the pattern going!

ba.prompt.lights.middle.text: One light is missing. Which one fits the pattern?

ba.prompt.signal.text: Watch the marshaller. What should the plane do?

ba.prompt.signal2.text: Two signals! Do the first one, then the second one.

ba.count.howMany.text: Everyone is on! How many passengers got on the plane?

ba.check.text: All set? Press the green button to check!

ba.help.bags.colour.text: Look at the bag's colour. Then find the plane with the same colour.

ba.help.bags.shape.text: This time, look at the shape on the tag. The colour doesn't matter!

ba.help.bags.both.text: Check two things: the colour and the shape. Both have to match.

ba.help.count.text: Touch each passenger once and say one number. The last number tells how many!

ba.help.make.text: Count each passenger as they climb on. Stop at Ziggy's number!

ba.help.lights.text: Say the colours out loud. The pattern repeats again and again.

ba.help.signal.text: The wand points the way to go. Crossed wands mean stop!

ba.help.signal2.text: Look at signal one, then signal two. Do them in that order.

ba.hint.bags.colour.text: Some bags are on the wrong plane. Check each colour again.

ba.hint.bags.shape.text: Some bags are on the wrong plane. Look closely at each tag's shape.

ba.hint.bags.both.text: Some bags match only one thing. Check the colour and the shape.

ba.hint.count.text: Let's count again. Touch each window and say one number.

ba.hint.tooMany.text: Oops, too many! Send some back, and count again.

ba.hint.tooFew.text: We need more passengers. Keep counting as they climb aboard.

ba.hint.lights.text: Say the pattern out loud with me. What comes next?

ba.hint.signal.point.text: Follow the pointing wand with your finger. That's the way to go!

ba.hint.signal.stop.text: Wands crossed up high mean stop!

ba.hint.signal.ahead.text: Both wands waving towards the chest mean come straight ahead.

ba.hint.signal.slow.text: Wands patting down low mean slow down.

ba.hint.signal2.text: Look at signal one first. Then do signal two.

ba.hint.yourTurn.text: Your turn! Press the glowing one.

ba.retry.text: Hmm, not quite. Let's look again.

ba.praise.bags.1.text: Every bag on the right plane. You checked carefully!

ba.praise.bags.2.text: You looked at each bag before you loaded it!

ba.praise.bags.3.text: Careful matching! The bags are ready to fly.

ba.praise.count.text: {nWord}! You gave every passenger one number.

ba.praise.count2.text: You counted every passenger, one by one!

ba.praise.make.text: {nWord} passengers, just right! You stopped at the right number.

ba.praise.make2.text: You counted carefully and stopped right on time!

ba.praise.lights.1.text: You kept the pattern going! The runway glows.

ba.praise.lights.2.text: You said the pattern and found what comes next!

ba.praise.signal.2.text: You followed the signal. The little plane is right on track!

ba.praise.signal2.text: First one, then the other. You followed both signals!

ba.idle.text: Ziggy is waiting for you. Tap or drag to help!
